releases.name: Bridgit 1.6.0
releases.notes: Adds optional phone controls, sensors, private file sharing, video, on-device OCR and transcription, screen-sharing approval, usage, notification and Health Connect reads, and owner-approved clipboard copying. New switches start off. Strengthens per-agent permissions, retry handling, timed-setting restoration and privacy after an interrupted tour.

releases.name: Bridgit 1.5.4
releases.notes: Approved bridgit wordmark and updated spelling. Original app icon, signing key and existing agent pairings retained.

releases.name: Bridget 1.5.3
releases.notes: Crash reports: when Bridget crashes or freezes it sends the error to Sentry (no photos, keys or location). Turn it off in Settings > Privacy.

releases.name: Bridget 1.5.2
releases.notes: HTML cards from agents, a live text panel, use Bridget over MCP, a Quick Settings tile, signed callbacks, screenshots on request, City tour notification with Ask/Pause/End, and fixes from a security review.

releases.name: Bridget 1.5.1
releases.notes: Applets tab with the City tour screen; Agents moved into More; a Share link on every What can Bridget do? card that opens its API details.

releases.name: Bridget 1.5.0
releases.notes: Interactions: agents can ask you questions and send notices; answer from the notification or the new Interactions tab, expand or close them. Agents can also check your location with the compass and play or speak audio on the phone.

releases.name: Bridget 1.4.4
releases.notes: Camera zoom for agents, every option listed in What can Bridget do?, an Install Tailscale link when it's missing, and agents now learn new features after an update by themselves.

releases.name: Bridget 1.4.3
releases.notes: "What can Bridget do?" now starts with everything your agents can ask the phone to do, each with an example; the technical part is below.

releases.name: Bridget 1.4.2
releases.notes: Blue colours with clearer contrast, and "What can Bridget do?" in More: every feature with an example, available now and planned.

releases.name: Bridget 1.4.1
releases.notes: New bridge icon. Home shows the icon, the version and the full name, Agentic Android Device Bridge. After you allow installs, the update carries on by itself.

releases.name: Bridget 1.4.0
releases.notes: Report a bug and Request a feature on the phone (developer agents can read reports and mark them fixed), Check for updates, and a new app icon.

releases.name: Bridget 1.3.0 (P1a)
releases.notes: Phase P1a, see PR #2. Signed with the existing release key (cert SHA-256 6bbd482d18efdc58ca28de8358405602ebb0405b479cabd36b37ff8242042f61). APK SHA-256 8d091f15ea0bd721ca3c57a928698865a6480268d29fad48bdb207494e45aaa6. Not compatible with 1.2: uninstall 1.2.0 first, then pair agents again (spec D20). Install: adb install -r bridget-1.3.0-release.apk
